task.question: What did Prime Minister Lecornu survive in January 2026 in France?
task.evidence: 23 January – Prime minister Lecornu survives two no-confidence motions filed against him by the LFI and RN over his efforts to pass the government's budget through rarely-invoked provisions of the constitution.
